notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: Toggle the reference against either render. The previous render is the dist-gated recreation. The revised one opens the 40 x 40 seat by the press clearance per side and narrows the M3 holes to Ø2.6 pilots (the tap class); the taper and the lip keep their size. It also fills the aperture's four corners with pads, through which Ø5 x 10 fan screws cut their thread in the fan's holes on its 32 mm square. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the renders are its output.
